# Game Theory Simulator and Solver

This is a web app I built to visualize the process of solving normal form games in various ways. It currently supports:

* Iterated Deletion of Strictly Dominated Strategies (Dominance-Solvability) (*in progress*)
* Best-Responses and Nash Equilibria (*in progress*)
